items.title: John Batiste "Bat" Stecklet Interview, 1959-06-15
items.q: Alderman Mitchell used to play guitar with him

ctx.x: That nigga could play a violin. Did he read? Huh? Did he read? No, he never read. He was a faker? Faker. And he had, Alderman Mitchell used to play guitar with him, and Henry Ford used to play bass. And he used to take different jobs, this fella Johnny Gould, you know, to play house for it. And that was all his band, three pieces, violin, guitar and bass. But he used to play plenty of jobs. When was that?
How old were you? Were you started on the carnet then?
